notes_for_editor: Thin. The Eastern US Lookouts page gives only the name and county. Mapcarta's tower point matches the record's coordinates (29.3257, -81.49546) and gives a 49 ft (15 m) elevation, but it is a gazetteer entry built from OpenStreetMap and GeoNames, not a site report. The Florida chapter report names the Seville fire tower only in passing, gives no year for the operation it describes, and does not say whether the tower was staffed, rented or simply kept. Wikipedia's Seville article has no tower mention. Not on the NHLR Florida list (31) or the FFLOS Florida list (6) in the cache. Record elevation_m is null; Mapcarta's 15 m could be added if the editor accepts a gazetteer figure. Status, access and staffing unknown.
